unit: Algebra · Chapter 4. Continuity and the derivative
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 11 mathematics textbooks (general stream)

stages.headline: Polynomials, rational functions, √x, aˣ, logₐ x, sin x and cos x are continuous on their domains.
stages.headlineEnglish: Polynomials, rational functions, √x, aˣ, logₐ x, sin x and cos x are continuous on their domains.

stages.headline: Sums, products, quotients (nonzero denominator) and compositions of continuous functions are continuous, so limits are found by substitution.
stages.headlineEnglish: Sums, products, quotients (nonzero denominator) and compositions of continuous functions are continuous, so limits are found by substitution.

stages.headline: A function continuous on [a; b] takes all intermediate values; if f(a) and f(b) have opposite signs, f(x) = 0 has a root in (a; b).
stages.headlineEnglish: A function continuous on [a; b] takes all intermediate values; if f(a) and f(b) have opposite signs, f(x) = 0 has a root in (a; b).

stages.headline: Does x³ + x − 1 = 0 have a root in [0; 1]?

stages.problemText: Does x³ + x − 1 = 0 have a root in [0; 1]?
